HOW CPU DEALS WITH MEMORY AND I/O
 Memory Mapped I/O: 
No separate I/O instructions. Here CPU can use 
memory type instructions for I/O data. Eg: 8085

 Isolated I/O: 
Separate read write line. I/O read and I/O write are 
enabled during I/O transfer, same is for memory. 
Eg: 8086

 I/O Processor:
Independent set of address, data and control bus, 
one for memory and other for i/o. Separate i/o 
processor than CPU. Purpose of i/o proc. is to 
provide independent pathway for the transfer of 
info. between external devices and internal m/y
